mapper.sql: select b.id, b.reader_id, b.book_id, b.borrow_time, b.due_time, b.return_time, b.status, b.renew_count, b.del_flag, b.create_by, b.create_time, b.update_by, b.update_time, b.remark, b.dept_id, r.real_name as reader_name, r.card_no, i.book_name as book_name, i.isbn from book_borrow b left join book_reader r on b.reader_id = r.id left join book_info i on b.book_id = i.id
mapper.insert:
insert into book_borrow
reader_id, book_id, borrow_time, due_time, return_time, status, renew_count, del_flag, dept_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark,
#{readerId}, #{bookId}, #{borrowTime}, #{dueTime}, #{returnTime}, #{status}, #{renewCount}, #{delFlag}, #{deptId}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark},
mapper.update:
update book_borrow
reader_id = #{readerId}, book_id = #{bookId}, borrow_time = #{borrowTime}, due_time = #{dueTime}, return_time = #{returnTime}, status = #{status}, renew_count = #{renewCount}, del_flag = #{delFlag}, dept_id = #{deptId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime}, remark = #{remark},
where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
update book_borrow set del_flag = '2', update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update book_borrow set status = '2', update_time = now(), update_by = 'system' where status = '0' and due_time < now() and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select:
select b.id, b.reader_id, b.book_id, b.borrow_time, b.due_time, b.status, b.dept_id, r.real_name as reader_name, r.card_no, i.book_name, i.isbn, CASE WHEN b.dept_id = #{currentDeptId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_local from book_borrow b left join book_reader r on b.reader_id = r.id left join book_info i on b.book_id = i.id where b.status in ('0', '2') and b.del_flag = '0'
and r.card_no like concat('%', #{cardNo}, '%')
and i.book_name like concat('%', #{bookName}, '%')
order by b.borrow_time desc
